title: Kusanagi Nene — Wonderlands×Showtime〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's start our planning meeting!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I want our next show to feature innovative elements never before seen on stage! So, let's get brainstorming!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: How about, how about we all fly!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That gets points for showiness, but not for innovation. Give me something better than this!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, then... A show where we EXPLODE!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And why would we want to do that?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Because then everyone will have a blast!
And we can have colorful smoke and effects!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I want to explode into a red cloud of smoke!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
If anything, I'd be getting red smoke.
Since ancient times, red has been the color reserved for leaders!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Unfortunately, Emu, having the stage filled with smoke would make it impossible for the audience to see anything! And for this reason, I must reject this idea too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Has anyone else got anything?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Well, I—

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Me, me!
Same idea but without the smoke!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Forget about explosions, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: AHEM...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It seems Nene has a suggestion.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But—ngh!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Did he just shove a donut into Emu's mouth so fast my eyes couldn't follow?!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Mmm? Nom nom...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (He didn't need to shut Emu up for me...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Rui has taken Robo-Nene for upgrades...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And once they're complete, I'd like to perform together with her.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Tsukasa will probably shoot down my suggestion because he wouldn't want Robo-Nene to steal his spotlight.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay, so we'd be using Robo-Nene for our next play. But what sort of performance do you have in mind?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (That...was a more positive reaction than I was expecting.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Well that... That depends on what upgrades Rui is going to give her...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If I might offer my suggestion, the play could begin with only Robo-Nene on stage...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hmm, yeah! That's cool!
Let's tumble with this idea!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's let's roll with, not tumble!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Anyhow, I like the novelty of it.
You got me on board.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's...cool.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I can't wait to see Robo-Nene Version 2.0!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Be patient. It'll be worth the wait.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Go ahead and give her all the upgrades you can think of, but she's not going to outshine me, for I am the true star!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The brightest star in the constellation of Goofus.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: G-Goofus?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And since you're relatively cool... You're a red dwarf! Rufous Goofus!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I...don't want to be called that!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A clever rhyme, Emu. Rufous Goofus has a nice ring to it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Can you please stop!
It sounds dumb!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's why it suits you perfectly, Rufous Goofus...Doofus.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
How dare you!
And don't add to it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Rufous Goofus, Rufous Doofus♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Don't make it into a song!
Stop dancing to it!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe.
